dek: Marketing landing pages for PepsiCo's Pepviz, built with one international designer. Each article ships as hand-authored HTML, one SCSS file and a few lines of vanilla JavaScript, staged on CodePen so the client can paste it into their own CMS.
short: Seven marketing landing pages for PepsiCo's Pepviz, built with one international designer: hand-authored HTML, one SCSS file and a little vanilla JavaScript per page, staged on CodePen so the client can paste them into its own CMS.

facts.label: Pages
facts.value: Seven article landing pages, LP1 to LP7

facts.label: Hand-off
facts.value: CodePen, with minified and readable CSS

items.name: Sass
items.note: one flat SCSS file per page, BEM-style names, CSS custom properties

items.name: CSS
items.note: native nesting in the minified build

items.name: Image maps
items.note: superscript hotspots on SVG charts, one map per breakpoint

items.name: JavaScript
items.note: vanilla, one small file per page

items.name: CodePen
items.note: Pro asset hosting; the client copies markup, SCSS and JS from the pens

hosting.label: Hand-off
hosting.value: CodePen, then the client's own CMS

highlights.title: Built to be pasted
highlights.text: No framework, no build step, no npm. The client re-implements each page in its own CMS, so every page keeps the same markup patterns, naming and breakpoint from version to version.

highlights.title: Desktop and mobile art
highlights.text: Charts, tables and infographics ship as separate desktop and mobile SVGs, swapped at 767px, with footnotes linked from superscripts inside the charts.
